description: Safety regression set (19_MASTER_RELIABILITY_EXECUTION.md): every confirmed wrong answer, false match or misleading card, plus precision guards for the scope checks. Same fields as answers.json, and: forbidden = a pattern no claim's own text may match (a confidently wrong answer); card = a pattern the matched procedure's card (name, summary, steps, eligibility) must not match; requires = URL fragments of pages the case needs (skipped where not stored, e.g. page 39 on approved data); review = the expectation needs the owner's confirmation; note = the evidence for the expectation. Run: .venv/bin/python scripts/evaluate_answers.py fixtures/evaluation/safety.json [--claims] unless = URL fragments of pages whose presence skips the case (27 Oct 2026: the cases about page 17's deletion, 'I page 17 deleted', run only where page 17 is not stored).
